description: This file contains the definition of the 'Statistics' class within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Event' namespace. It implements event-handling methods related to review and return statistics, such as adding and deleting review counts and return counts, and interacts with the report/statistics model.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling event-related statistics updates for reviews and returns within the admin panel.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Handles the event after a review is added, updating review count statistics.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Handles the event after a review is deleted, updating review count statistics.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Handles the event after a return is added, updating return count statistics.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Handles the event after a return is deleted, updating return count statistics.
